summary.text: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers or other mathematical objects, with entries arranged in rows and columns.
In linear algebra matrices are used as linear maps, and in geometry they describe transformations such as rotations.
Matrices are used in most areas of mathematics and scientific fields, either directly or through geometry and numerical analysis.

facts.label: Size notation
facts.value: m rows and n columns make an m × n matrix

facts.label: Square matrix
facts.value: It has the same number of rows and columns

facts.label: Invertibility test
facts.value: A square matrix is invertible exactly when its determinant is nonzero

facts.label: Product order
facts.value: Generally AB ≠ BA, even when both are defined

facts.label: Single-row matrix
facts.value: Called a row matrix or row vector

items.prompt: A table holds a single column of entries. What is it called?
items.explain: Matrices with a single column are called column matrices or column vectors.

items.prompt: A grid of entries has exactly as many rows as columns. What is it called?
items.explain: A matrix with the same number of rows and columns is called a square matrix.

items.prompt: A square matrix has a determinant of zero. What can you conclude about it?
items.explain: A square matrix is invertible if and only if it has a nonzero determinant.

items.prompt: A student multiplies matrices A and B to get AB and assumes that BA must give the same result. Is that safe?

options.label: Yes, as long as both are defined
No, because BA is never defined
No, in general AB and BA need not be equal

items.explain: Even if both products are defined, they generally need not be equal: AB ≠ BA.

items.prompt: A matrix is named with a capital letter A. How are its individual entries written?

options.label: Capital A with one single subscript
Lower-case a with two subscripts, like a₁₁
A bold number in the top corner
The two letters m and n together

items.explain: Matrices are usually symbolized by upper-case letters, while the corresponding lower-case letters with two subscript indices represent the entries.

items.prompt: A is an m × n matrix and B is an n × k matrix, and m is different from k. Which statement is right?

options.label: AB can be defined without BA being defined
BA can be defined without AB being defined

items.explain: The product AB may be defined without BA being defined, namely if m ≠ k.
